risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant credit risks due to the nature of its financial guarantee operations. Defaults by bond issuers it insures would result in direct claims.

risks.title: Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in financial markets, interest rates, and credit spreads directly impact demand for financial guarantee products and the valuation of the investment portfolio.

risks.title: Integration - Assured Life Re Acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Assured Life Re in life insurance and annuities presents significant integration risks due to differences in culture, processes, and business models between financial guaranty and life reinsurance operations.

risks.title: Regulation and Ratings
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulation or downgrades by rating agencies could significantly affect demand for financial guarantee products.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Risks
risks.score_rationale: Economic recession, accelerated inflation, tariffs, and geopolitical uncertainty may increase bond issuer defaults and reduce demand for new guarantee products.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where other insurers and credit providers offer similar services.

risks.title: Geopolitical Exposure Risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts such as Russia's invasion of Ukraine may create exposure to sanctions, energy market disruptions, and payment defaults.
